name: Attention
description: Search, analyze, and take action on your sales conversations directly from Claude. Attention captures every call and email, extracts key insights, and syncs intelligence to your other apps automatically. With this connector, you can query call transcripts across your team, surface objections and trends, review scorecards, analyze deal health, and create shareable snippets - all through natural language. Turn every customer conversation into structured data, coaching opportunities, and closed deals without leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Attention to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Attention to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.attention.tech/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Attention MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attention provides these MCP tools: search_calls, get_call_details, ask_attention, create_snippet, get_org_overview, get_scorecards, list_teams, get_team, get_team_members, and list_reps.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Attention?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Attention in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Attention requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Attention is developed by Attention. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
